title: Triple Click
html:
There is a rumor that goes around the game regarding a special method for getting extra loot from chests. Some players believe that if you stand well back from the chest, and very quickly triple click, the loot doubles!

Experimentation shows that it does indeed seem to work quite a bit of the time. Often for a solo player, instead of only one stack of gold or one article per chest, there will indeed be two. It also seems to actually double the loot for each member of a group. Whether it is consistent and which situations it works in are still unclear. It has seemed to work both on Level chests and Boss chests.

In fact, experimentation has even produced two Relic Guardians, and a consequent drop of double relics. Of course you have to fight not only both Guardians but also double Summoned Trophy Guardians as well.

In Build 122 it does not seem to work as often. So far two Relic Guardians and double relics have not appeared in this Build.

Hopefully, we will get more reports posted here. This is a wiki, and we always need your experience!
